title: Story premise ENT105: The Comet Tail Repair Shop
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: Your tail is not broken. It is badly introduced. Takeaway/theme: A repair can preserve character rather than erase it.
description: A mechanic must repair a comet’s tangled decorative tail before a parade, but brushing it straight removes every playful curl. They arrange the curls into a deliberate spiral ribbon, attach a tiny parade bell, and send the comet off with its unusual tail proudly intact.
